dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: I've prepared two boxes of books about animals. We should be able to find the solution to any health issues they might have right away!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Forget health issues — Paimon wouldn't be surprised if she could actually chat with the animals once she's done reading...

response.speaker: Giustina
response.text: Wait, Head Nurse, please don't go! Whew, boy am I glad I caught up with you!

response.speaker: Giustina
response.text: One of the inmates has become obsessed with those "Magical Mouse Munchies" from the animated films you've been showing them — and tried making some himself with three days' worth of Welfare Meals...

response.speaker: Giustina
response.text: He ended up giving himself food poisoning, with symptoms we've never even seen before! Please, we need your help!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Eh? We warned them not to take those films too seriously...

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: But if you've chased me all this way, things must be pretty serious!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: I'm really sorry... I'll have to ask you to help me take my luggage to the amusement park for now.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Before you arrived, I was thinking through some emergencies that might occur with the animals. I even started putting some suggestions together.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: You can give them to the staff at the Mellow Manor in advance. They should come in handy soon!

choices.text: No rush, we'll be waiting for you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sigewinne sure has it tough! Not only does she have to worry about taking care of her patients, she also has to clean up after those troublemakers...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why don't we prepare something tasty for her? It might help lift her spirits!

choices.text: Your patients' health is the top priority!
